data:
[1] Librarians manage the catalogue and loans. Members browse books and see their own loans.

[2] FR-001 The librarian shall add, edit and remove books in the catalogue.

[3] FR-002 The librarian shall register a loan of a book to a member.

[4] FR-003 A member shall see the list of books currently on loan to them.
description: Users, roles and functional requirements of the Library Lending BRD
